plumbing.review:
- **[P2] Ripgrep’s help flag publishes false file reads.** [shell.go:294](shell.go:294) shares `-h` between `grep` and `rg`, but ripgrep uses it to print help and exit. With an existing `app.go`, `rg -h needle app.go` becomes `search` and publishes `app.go`, violating the requirement to publish only certain read/search operands. Split the flag sets and add regression coverage for both agents, while running and after completion.

Otherwise, file scope, documentation, timing, colors and code style align with the plan. Acceptance sources match the ratified versions; existing assertions weren’t weakened. I found no added command execution or network access. The factory reports all checks passed; this review was static.

VERDICT: changes needed — classify ripgrep help invocations as other with no files and add regression coverage.
